title: Fix Detail Panel Line Alignment Using Playwright
description: Fix the sketchpad detail panel lines so they align with tree elements like in the storybook. Use Playwright to verify the fix.
summary: Fixed tree indentation lines 0.5px misalignment by subtracting half the line width from positioning. Playwright measurements confirm perfect 0.0px alignment across all tree rows. 13/13 unit tests pass.
